prompt: The camera does not move. Brandon brushes in firm, even strokes, jaw set and eyes unblinking on the mirror. Later he leans in a fraction, narrows his eyelids and gives a single sharp nod to himself. The fluorescent tube hums and flickers once. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Rhythmic bristle scrub, a tap dripping slowly, the electrical buzz of the tube, a pipe knocking in the wall. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
